# Waymark

> Waymark is a free, open-source (MIT) suite of lightweight tools for sound engineering, AV and conferences, published at waymarked.site. Every tool is portable and runs locally and offline, with no installation, admin rights, accounts or cloud server needed. Status: in testing, no stable release yet.

## Principles

- Portable apps (one file per system) and the web only; no installers, no admin rights, runs from USB
- Local and offline: devices talk directly over the venue's local network; presentation content never leaves it
- No cloud server needed, no accounts, cookies, telemetry, ads or paid services; an optional self-hosted relay joins two computers with no shared network and sees only encrypted data
- MIT licence; built first for real events, then given freely
- Dark theme by default plus a light theme; Greek and English; 24-hour clock

## First tool: Waymark Remote

A minimal remote tool that connects operator, secretariat and speaker computers over any local network (wired or wireless) to open, check and control presentations and transfer files, without installing anything on the speaker's computer.

- Roles: Secretariat (sends files to rooms, sees status), Operator (opens and runs the presentation from a laptop or Android phone), Overview (watches every room, can take over)
- Built-in presentation check on the laptop that will play the file (missing fonts, videos, slides that fail, screen ratio); fixes only on a copy
- Pairing required on the speaker's laptop, visible connection indicator, one-click disconnect, encrypted, stays on the LAN

Release steps (no dates yet):
- 0.1: presentation control and file transfer (shared folders, drag and drop)
- 0.2: screen view and Agent Lite (browser-only agent)
- 0.3: full remote control (mouse, keyboard, live video)

Platforms: Windows (exe), macOS (.app), Linux (AppImage), Android (APK), iPhone/iPad (browser). Unsigned for now.

## Later tools

Time and speakers (timer, stage display, run of show, phone remote, overview), presenting and playout, presentation/PDF/media checks, crew and sound tools, and Waymark Kit (equipment checklists).

## Support

Waymark is free and stays free; buying or donating unlocks nothing. Optional support: https://waymarked.site/support/ (Waymark merch from the Glarolykoi shop, a one-time donation, or hiring the author). Waymark has no paid services.

## Media kit

Logos, wallpapers, banners, print files, palette and press texts (EN, EL): https://waymarked.site/media-kit/

## Ελληνικά

Το Waymark είναι δωρεάν σειρά εργαλείων ανοιχτού κώδικα (MIT) για ηχοληψία, οπτικοακουστικά και συνέδρια. Portable, τοπικά και offline, χωρίς εγκατάσταση ή ανάγκη για cloud. Πρώτο εργαλείο: Waymark Remote. Βρίσκεται σε δοκιμές, χωρίς σταθερή έκδοση ακόμη.

Designed by Christos Koulaxizis.
